provenance.dataset: GSE139944 / GSM4150377 sciPlex2 A549 Transcription Modulators
provenance.normalization: per-cell sum over all original genes to 10000, then log1p, before HVG selection

hvg.method: train-only log1p-CP10K variance descending; original annotation order breaks ties

provenance.feature_namespace: original unique versioned Ensembl gene IDs
provenance.duplicate_symbols: not merged; symbol is a display annotation only
provenance.source_population_for_fitted_statistics: split=train only; no validation/test expression used for gene selection
provenance.baseline_controls: all quality-passing zero-dose cells, with exact drug+plate+author replicate matching
provenance.replicates: author culture-well column labels; independence beyond author-defined triplicates unverified

training.resume_semantics: epoch boundary; interrupted partial epoch is not replayed

selection_metric: mean squared error per cell-gene in validation normalized log1p expression
uniform_centering: subtract unweighted per-axis state mean; not an untreated state
split_verification: caller provided train/val; biological replicate independence must be established in preparation provenance
limitations: Reduced-width architecture and coexpression scaffold are pilot changes.
Low reconstruction MSE alone does not validate state semantics or perturbation prediction.
Uniformly centered states are relative effects, not absolute gene expression.
MSE decoder output is unbounded and may be negative; no clipping is applied to preserve exact additivity.
Observed single-cell baseline expression contains reconstruction residual not explained by the codes.
